error_handling.rule: If a browser_* tool call fails: 1. Check if the page is still loaded (browser_snapshot) 2. If page crashed, browser_navigate back to the URL 3. If element not found, re-run browser_snapshot to get fresh refs 4. If timeout, use browser_wait_for time=3 then retry

If browser_click/type fails with "element not found": - The snapshot ref may be stale (page changed since last snapshot) - Call browser_snapshot again to get updated refs - If element is in a modal/dropdown that appeared, the new snapshot will have it - As fallback, use CSS selector: target="css=button.submit"

If browser_navigate fails or returns error: - Check if the URL is correct - Try browser_wait_for time=5 then browser_snapshot to see current state - Check browser_console_messages for JS errors that may have blocked rendering

Screenshots are saved inside the container. If you need to verify a screenshot was captured, the host path is: /home/celes/.local/share/playwright-mcp/{filename} You can verify with: list_files at that directory

If your context is getting large from many tool results: - Use browser_evaluate with filename param to save large outputs to files - Reference files by path instead of including full content - Summarize findings as you go in evidence.md rather than holding everything in context
